children: Water technology products maker's Q3 sales rose 19%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted diluted EPS for Q3 climbed 36%, beating analyst expectations
Company raised full-year 2026 sales and margin outlook
Company raises 2026 sales growth outlook to 17%-18% reported, 11%-12% organic
Watts expects 2026 operating margin of 21.6%-21.7%, adjusted margin of 20.3%-20.4%
DATA CENTER DEMAND - Co said higher sales volumes were primarily driven by growth in data center applications and favorable price realization
ACQUISITIONS - Acquisitions in the Americas and APMEA contributed to reported sales growth, along with a minor benefit from foreign exchange
PRICE REALIZATION AND PRODUCTIVITY - Adjusted operating margin rose due to favorable pricing, higher sales volume leverage, and productivity gains, partly offset by inflation and acquisition dilution
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the industrial machinery & equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Watts Water Technologies, Inc. is $408.72, about 13.4% above its November 3 closing price of $360.33
The stock recently traded at 26 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 27 three months ago
